title: vwa-1998-world-heavyweight
label: Alex Extreme

won.source: Defeated Predator with a moonsault into a legdrop finisher in the main event of the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast.

lost.note: The title had passed to Nick Danger by the time of the promotion's own next surviving broadcast; no document in the held record shows how or when it changed hands.

note: The manner of this reign's ending is not attested in the held record.

won.source: The promotion's own 13 December 1997 broadcast recaps President Todd Bloom presenting him the title "last month" at the promotion's own Hardcore Hell pay-per-view.

won.note: Already billed as reigning World Heavyweight Champion entering the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast; no surviving document shows how he won it.

lost.note: Lost the title to Alex Extreme in the main event of the same broadcast.

title: vwa-1998-north-american
label: Predator

won.source: Defeated Roger Rampage by rollup for the title on the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast; the title's own status entering that match is not stated.

lost.note: The title had passed to King Suicide by the time of the promotion's own next surviving broadcast; no document in the held record shows how or when it changed hands.

note: The manner of this reign's ending is not attested in the held record.

won.source: Billed as the reigning North American Champion, title belt in hand, on the promotion's own 13 December 1997 broadcast; no document in the held record shows how he won it from Predator.
Reversed a top-rope move into a rollup to win the title from Dirty Doug Foreyes on the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast.

won.note: Already billed as reigning Cruiserweight Champion entering the promotion's own 4 October 1997 broadcast; no surviving document shows how he won it.

lost.note: Lost the title to Quezzy in an instant reversal on the same broadcast.

won.source: Billed as the promotion's reigning Tag Team Champions on its own 13 December 1997 broadcast; no document in the held record shows how the team won the title.
